title: LvisXVI/modspire

title: Acelith/Chronexus

title: mirzatghayrat/arslan
summary: Open-source AI agent for your Mac and iPhone — runs your terminal and apps in the background, and asks before it acts. Local-first, bring your own key.

title: gstdcoin/gstdbot

title: MBarc/nectra

Describe a crew in YAML, TypeScript (.ork.ts) or C# — one runtime executes all three. Cloud and local LLMs, a staged RAG pipeline, and a virtual file system every tool goes through.

title: SMESCH1/InforMessi
summary: Automated daily Telegram pipeline about the Argentine national team. LLMs + RAG anti-repetition + GitHub Actions

title: mkhellat/codebud

title: heyvaldemar/anythingllm-traefik-letsencrypt-docker-compose

title: gerfru/NilesAI

title: motock/fagan

Source-available. Your own AI Automation software, with native build instructions for macOS, Windows, WSL (Ubuntu), and Docker. iOS, Android, Store Apps separate
